source_title: Madurai Meenakshi Temple Power Outage Sparks Political Row as EPS Hits Out - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
A power outage at Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple during AIADMK chief Edappadi K. Palaniswami's visit has triggered a political controversy in Tamil Nadu. Palaniswami criticised the administration, stating people cannot even pray peacefully. In response, the power minister claimed the interruption lasted only seven to eight minutes due to a generator switchover and maintenance, while also alleging possible deliberate foul play during VIP visits to defame the government. The incident comes amid soaring electricity demand in the state.
